senses.def: the fatty flesh of eel; an elongate fish found in fresh water in Europe and America; large eels are usually smoked or pickled
voracious snakelike marine or freshwater fishes with smooth slimy usually scaleless skin and having a continuous vertical fin but no ventral fins

ex: an eerie feeling of deja vu

senses.def: inspiring a feeling of fear; strange and frightening
ex: an uncomfortable and eerie stillness in the woods
it was eerily quiet in the chapel
